done_when: Files the repo marks as generated in .gitattributes (linguist-generated) appear in the review bundle only as their name and changed-line counts. A change to a file a fix's Done-when names counts as a change the review must see, even under plans/.
why: Review bundles include generated files such as migration snapshots, which split one review into many passes, and a change to a plans/ file that a fix's Done-when names doesn't trigger a new review, so stale findings stay
